description: Ministry of Lands - Regulations made to amend the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1864/54 of 30.05.2014 (Para,f.)
reasoning: This gazette content contains amendments to the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act (Act No. 460) through a statutory instrument (P. 9/2013). It specifically modifies sections of the Act related to licensing requirements and financial guarantees for fisheries activities, which constitutes legal/regulatory changes rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
